projects.name: NeuroFuse
projects.description: B.Tech major project (team) at VNRVJIET. A CycleGAN synthesises CT scans from brain MRIs, the Diff-IF diffusion model fuses MRI and CT into one image, and deep-learning classifiers (ConvNeXt, ViT, Swin, DenseNet) detect tumors; fused MRI+CT reached up to 98.88% accuracy. Paper accepted (not yet published) at IEEE ICCCMLA 2026.

projects.name: IncluHub – Programme Workflow Dashboard
projects.description: Full-stack role-based dashboard for an inclusive creative-education programme. Admin, educator, student and external-member roles move teams through a 6-stage programme (onboarding to brand works), with portfolio approvals, studio scheduling and brand opportunities. Supabase Postgres with row-level security (32 tables), deployed on Vercel.

projects.name: DoctorGemma
projects.description: LoRA fine-tune of Google Gemma for medical Q&A.

projects.name: Intelli-Credit
projects.description: AI credit decisioning engine (with Venkata) that ingests GST, ITR, bank statements, annual reports and litigation data to auto-generate Credit Appraisal Memos with lend/no-lend recommendations, suggested limits and risk premiums for Indian credit workflows. Includes India-specific PDF/data pipelines and a research agent over MCA and e-Courts to detect circular trading, revenue inflation and litigation exposure.

projects.name: Multimodal Medical Image Fusion for Brain Tumor Detection
projects.description: Analysed 10+ multimodal fusion techniques across 8 metrics (PSNR, SSIM, Dice, etc.) on 5+ public datasets (BraTS, TCIA and others). Documented state-of-the-art results and open challenges (data scarcity, registration errors), and outlined directions for sub-200 ms inference.
